001package org.clafer.objective;
002
003import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
004import org.clafer.ast.AstSetExpr;
005import org.clafer.frontend.SourceSpan;
006import org.clafer.common.Check;
007
008/**
009 * One objective. Use either
010 * {@link Objective#maximize(org.clafer.ast.AstSetExpr)} or
011 * {@link Objective#minimize(org.clafer.ast.AstSetExpr)} to construct a new
012 * objective.
013 *
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class Objective {
017
018    private static final AtomicInteger idFactory = new AtomicInteger();
019    private final int id = idFactory.getAndIncrement();
020    // true - maximize
021    // false - minimize
022    private final boolean maximize;
023    private final AstSetExpr expr;
024    private final SourceSpan span;
025
026    private Objective(boolean maximize, AstSetExpr expr, SourceSpan span) {
027        this.maximize = maximize;
028        this.expr = Check.notNull(expr);
029        this.span = span;
030    }
031
032    /**
033     * Check if this objective is a maximization objective.
034     *
035     * @return {@code true} if the objective is to maximize the expression,
036     * {@code false} otherwise
037     */
038    public boolean isMaximize() {
039        return maximize;
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * Check if this objective is a minimization objective.
044     *
045     * @return {@code true} if the objective is to minimize the expression,
046     * {@code false} otherwise
047     */
048    public boolean isMinimize() {
049        return !maximize;
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * Returns the expression to optimize.
054     *
055     * @return the expression to optimize
056     */
057    public AstSetExpr getExpr() {
058        return expr;
059    }
060
061    /**
062     * Create a new maximization objective.
063     *
064     * @param expression the expression
065     * @return maximize the expression
066     */
067    public static Objective maximize(AstSetExpr expression) {
068        return maximize(expression, null);
069    }
070
071    /**
072     * Create a new maximization objective.
073     *
074     * @param expression the expression
075     * @param span where the objective is in the source model, or {@code null}
076     * if unknown
077     * @return maximize the expression
078     */
079    public static Objective maximize(AstSetExpr expression, SourceSpan span) {
080        return new Objective(true, expression, span);
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * Create a new minimization objective.
085     *
086     * @param expression the expression
087     * @return minimize the expression
088     */
089    public static Objective minimize(AstSetExpr expression) {
090        return minimize(expression, null);
091    }
092
093    /**
094     * Create a new minimization objective.
095     *
096     * @param expression the expression
097     * @param span where the objective is in the source model, or {@code null}
098     * if unknown
099     * @return minimize the expression
100     */
101    public static Objective minimize(AstSetExpr expression, SourceSpan span) {
102        return new Objective(false, expression, span);
103    }
104
105    public boolean hasSpan() {
106        return span != null;
107    }
108
109    /**
110     * Returns where the objective is in the source model.
111     *
112     * @return the source span, or {@code null} if unknown
113     */
114    public SourceSpan getSpan() {
115        return span;
116    }
117
118    @Override
119    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
120        return this == obj;
121    }
122
123    @Override
124    public int hashCode() {
125        return id;
126    }
127
128    @Override
129    public String toString() {
130        return "<<" + (maximize ? "max " : "min ") + expr + ">>" + (span == null ? "" : " at " + span);
131    }
132}
